// diagnostic

E1221

`package.jet` has a malformed `authority:` block.

What

`package.jet` has a malformed `authority:` block.

Why

`authority: { allow: […], deny: […], grants: { "dep": […] }, trust: { … }, providers: { … } }` is the one package authority block; rights use the thirteen grantable roots, the `FFI` parent and its language leaves including `FFI.Go`, `FFI.Py`, and `FFI.Octave`, and deny-only `Panic`/`Mem`.

Fix

Fix the authority field or right name.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1221: tests/ui/authority_scope_names_its_argument_as_a_string.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidAuthorityBlock]: The package's `authority:` block is malformed
  --> tests/ui/authority_scope_names_its_argument_as_a_string.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     authority: { allow: [FS.Read(data), IO] }
    |     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `FS.Read(data)` names its scope without quotes - write the scope as a string, like `FS.Read("data/")` or `Net("api.example.com")`
 Fix: `authority:` declares `allow`, `deny`, `needs`, `grants`, `trust`, and `providers` using canonical rights
